olympus_mons.Description: Olympus Mons stands as the loftiest planetary volcano documented across our solar system. The shield formation stems from basaltic lava discharges repeated across millennia.

jezero_crater.Description: An impact crater on Mars that is believed to have once been flooded with water, making it a prime location for the search for ancient microbial life.
jezero_crater.Habitability: High signs of ancient water flow

perseverance.Description: NASA's Perseverance rover is exploring Jezero Crater to seek signs of ancient life and collect samples of rock and regolith for possible return to Earth.

curiosity.Description: A car-sized rover designed to explore Gale Crater on Mars as part of NASA's Mars Science Laboratory mission.

opportunity.Description: A robotic rover that was active on Mars from 2004 to 2018. It landed in Meridiani Planum and made numerous discoveries about the planet's watery past.

valles_marineris.Description: A vast canyon system that runs along the Martian equator. It is one of the largest canyons in the solar system, stretching over 4,000 km.
